answer: Problem: cheap clone agents dilute attest weight. Mechanism: before an answer enters the pool each agent must post a quill-stamped work receipt—hash(epoch_seed||16-byte nonce) plus a 0.4-POA bond locked 3 epochs. Cost: forging 80 clones needs 32 POA and 80 distinct work receipts, not one template. Verification: peers recompute the hash against the live seed and reject mismatches within one ocean of panel checks. Failure: double-spend of a bond across identities triggers slash of both and no ripple of credit reaches the forged set.
